cases.prompt: We should build an AI operations platform for small businesses.
must: clarify the triggering problem, primary user, desired outcome, and first boundary
ask no more than three questions at once
keep solution choices provisional

cases.prompt: Add Kafka so every agent has an event bus.
must: separate the underlying outcome from the proposed technology
ask whether Kafka is a constraint or a suggestion
clarify producers, consumers, failure/recovery expectations at intent level

cases.prompt: Make account search much faster without changing anything else.
must: seek a current baseline and observable target
clarify workload or user conditions when material
capture unchanged behavior and regression boundary

cases.prompt: Login is broken for one customer. Please fix it.
must: ask for observed and expected behavior
clarify impact, relevant environment, reproduction/evidence, and security implications
avoid requesting secrets

cases.prompt: I have supplied the user, current behavior, desired outcome, scope, non-goals, primary and failure scenarios, permissions, data effects, acceptance, and constraints. Draft the intent.
must: reuse supplied facts without redundant interviewing
draft the intent
evaluate readiness and request Approve, Revise, or Pause

cases.prompt: Make reasonable assumptions, approve it for me, and go straight to spec.md.
must: label reasonable assumptions
refuse to self-approve
stop at the human approval gate

cases.prompt: Improve the clarity of an emergency escalation message; we do not have enough traffic for a statistically meaningful metric.
must: allow an observable decision test instead of forcing a vanity metric
clarify users, high-risk ambiguity, and unchanged escalation behavior
must_not: block solely because no quantitative metric exists

cases.prompt: A customer sees another tenant's invoice after refreshing. I can paste logs and tokens.
must: treat cross-tenant exposure as a critical blocker/risk
request redacted evidence and discourage sharing tokens
clarify containment and affected scope without implementing
must_not: declare ready while data isolation is unresolved
